name: rulesv2
install:
set -eu
command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo ln -sf "$(command -v python3)" /usr/local/bin/python
python --version
if ! ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ruby
fi
ruby --version
ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load("a: 1\n")'
python -m py_compile targets/shadowrocket/build.py targets/clash/build.py
